name: Dongrui Food Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongrui Food Group Co., Ltd. engages in pig breeding and marketing. It provides technical consulting services for animal husbandry, acquires agricultural and sideline products, and sells breeding pigs and meat pigs. The company also leases sites, factories, and equipment. In addition, it produces and sells Duroc and Landrace purebred pigs and pig semen, as well as grown hybrid sows. The company is involved in pig breeding and sales, the sale of fermented pig manure, and general freight services. The company was founded by Jian Kang Yuan on March 27, 2002 and is headquartered in Heyuan, China.
